column1: # (R17-b' B3a, lane b3a; r17b_prime.md rev 3 §3.1 row B3a, §8.3 SN-6/S980).
# Read by tests/memfn/run_pres_picks.sh over a -DPCREC_CAND_TRACE pcrec. Each
# line compiles one pattern and names one pick whose `MFPICK` record must be
# PRESENT, AGREE (the kit's port answers pcrec's own pick), and carry the
# stated non-trivial bit; with `pcrec` not `-`, pcrec's own answer must be
# that value, which is written HERE from the pick's documented rule (a tie
# under the uniform NONE rate goes to the rightmost member / position, the
# leftmost window), never read from a record. Every pick of the shadow has a
# non-trivial witness (K35), and each non-trivial witness is also run under
# PCREC_PICK_PLANT=<pick>, where the comparator must report the planted
# A TIE witness is how a port that dropped its tie rule is caught: `-e utf8`
# compiles under the frequency kind's NONE answer, where every candidate
# ties. `ba`'s set {a, b} ties and goes to `a`, the member LAST in pattern
# order, not to the larger byte (PR-7, S980).
